metadata.title: Who is responsible for deaths in  Ashram Schools | आश्रम स्कूलों में आदिवासी बच्चों की मौतें
metadata.description: Ashram and residential schools impart education up to secondary level to Children belonging to Scheduled tribes. But there are some shocking facts about residential schools in tribal areas. There are regular deaths of adivasi students in these schools due to snake bite or some illness. The parliament ’s standing committee has also submitted a report in 2014 about this issue. But no corrective measures to prevent deaths of Adivasi students are taken.
